payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited background, considered as a scene, show a recognizable basketball-court playing area rather than merely basketball equipment?
node.criteria: Pass if the visible background context identifies a basketball playing area, using the floor or court lines together with basketball context; fail if the assessable background is not a basketball playing area; unknown only if the background cannot be assessed. Do not require prominent markings when the scene otherwise clearly reads as a court.
node.binding: Compare the edited background with the source and requested replacement. Assess the background scene, not the unchanged foreground person. A hoop or ball alone is not sufficient, but equipment in a visible court setting can support recognition.

response.content: {"status":"pass","evidence":"The edited background clearly depicts a basketball playing area: a court floor with visible boundary/playing lines and a basketball hoop, with basketballs in the scene. This is more than basketball equipment alone.","confidence":0.99,"used_dependency_ids":[]}
